source: modelled from developers.miro.com/docs/miro-mcp-tools and the changelog 'Legacy MCP board tools have been removed' (read 2026-10-21); tools/list needs a Miro account and was not captured

tools.name: board_search_boards
tools.description: Search and list the boards the current user can open in the team chosen at authorization, by name, description, ownership or content.

query.description: Words to look for. Omit to list the boards.

tools.name: board_create
tools.description: Create a new board in the team chosen at authorization.

name.description: The name of the new board.

tools.name: canvas_search
tools.description: Find items on a board before reading them. With result_mode "overview", a high-level pass over frames, documents, prototypes, tables and diagrams.

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of an item of it (moveToWidget).

query.description: What to look for on the board.

tools.name: canvas_read_as_svg
tools.description: Read existing board items and return them as SVG; text content comes back as Markdown.

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of an item of it (moveToWidget).

tools.name: canvas_create_from_svg
tools.description: Create several board items at once from an SVG document written in the canvas composer format (see canvas_get_canvas_composer_skill).

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of the frame to create into (moveToWidget).

tools.name: canvas_update_from_svg
tools.description: Apply an SVG document to the board as a diff: items are created, updated and deleted to match it. Read the current items first; a document body is replaced whole.

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of an item of it (moveToWidget).

tools.name: canvas_get_canvas_composer_skill
tools.description: Get the specification of the SVG format the canvas tools read and write.

tools.name: canvas_load_format_skill
tools.description: Get the specification of one typed format (a diagram, a document, a table, a timeline...) for the canvas tools.

tools.name: comment_list_comments
tools.description: List the comments of a board, or of one item of it.

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of an item of it (moveToWidget).

tools.name: comment_create
tools.description: Start a comment thread on a board, or on one item of it.

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of an item of it (moveToWidget).

tools.name: comment_reply
tools.description: Add a reply to an existing comment thread.

comment_id.description: The comment thread to reply to.

tools.name: comment_resolve
tools.description: Resolve or reopen a comment thread.

resolved.description: true to resolve, false to reopen. Defaults to true.

tools.name: image_get_data
tools.description: Get the metadata and the image data (base64) of an image item.

tools.name: image_get_url
tools.description: Get a download URL for an image item.

tools.name: image_create
tools.description: Create an image item on a board from the URL of an image.

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of the frame to create into (moveToWidget).

image_url.description: The URL of the image to add.

tools.name: image_get_upload_url
tools.description: Get a temporary, single-use presigned URL to upload an image.

tools.name: prototype_read
tools.description: Read the prototype screens of a board, with their metadata.

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of a prototype of it (moveToWidget).

tools.name: prototype_create
tools.description: Create a prototype from one or more HTML screens.

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of the frame to create into (moveToWidget).

screens.description: The HTML screens of the prototype.

tools.name: table_create
tools.description: Create a table with the given columns (Miro marks the table tools as deprecating soon).

miro_url.description: URL of the board, or of the frame to create into (moveToWidget).

tools.name: table_list_rows
tools.description: Get the rows of a table with its column metadata, optionally filtered.

tools.name: table_sync_rows
tools.description: Add or update the rows of a table, matched on a key column.

rows.description: The rows to add or update.

key_column.description: The column rows are matched on.

tools.name: table_get_latest_update_history
tools.description: Get the latest changes made to a table.

tools.name: table_update_view
tools.description: Change how a table is shown (its view settings).

tools.name: user_who_am_i
tools.description: Get the profile of the current user.
